src.title: Ice Cream is Great for Weight Loss (vanilla 3 ways)

recipes.title: Low-Calorie Vanilla Creami – 'Good' (Milk + Almond Milk)
steps: Add the milks and vanilla to a pint. Mix the Swerve, xanthan gum and salt, then froth or blend the milk while slowly adding the dry mix; keep going 90 seconds.
Run under hot water 1 minute, spin on Ice Cream, then Re-spin once (twice for soft serve).
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video's narration. The lowest-calorie and cheapest of the three; macros are estimates (Swerve's carbs don't count).

recipes.title: Creamier Vanilla Creami – 'Better' (All Milk)
steps: Add the milk and vanilla to a pint. Mix the Swerve, xanthan gum and salt, then froth or blend the milk while slowly adding the dry mix; keep going 90 seconds.
Run under hot water 1 minute, spin on Ice Cream, then Re-spin once (twice for soft serve).
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video's narration: 440 g 1% milk, made from half fat-free and half 2% Fairlife. Dropping the almond milk makes it creamier with fewer ice crystals. Macros are estimates.

recipes.title: Vanilla Bean Creami – 'Best' (Egg Yolk + Vanilla Bean)
steps: In a tall container add the milk, egg yolk, vanilla and the seeds from half a vanilla bean (save the pod for homemade extract).

Mix the Swerve, xanthan gum and salt. With an immersion blender running, slowly add the dry mix, then blend 90 seconds; pour into a pint. (With a frother, the seeds sink: swirl the pint after 1 hour in the freezer.)
Run under hot water 1 minute, spin on Ice Cream and repeat until it's the texture you like.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video's narration; his pick of the three. On-screen macros: 285 cal, 13 g fat, 13 g net carbs (58 g total including the Swerve); protein shown as about 24 g. The egg yolk acts as an emulsifier for a smoother, richer texture.
